name: Ordell Minerals Limited
summary: Ordell Minerals Limited assesses, acquires and explores mineral properties in Australia, targeting gold, lithium, copper and nickel. Its holdings include the Barimaia Project in the Murchison Gold district of Western Australia, about 44 square kilometers across one mining lease, fifteen prospecting licenses and one exploration license, and the 80-square-kilometer Goodia Project in the Eastern Goldfields.
